report.summary: Chunk 3 of artifacts.py: defines _candidates, ArtifactEdge, ResolveReport, resolve_literals, and Column. Claims about LaTeX resolution, URL detection, and sorting are checkable; claims about external references and artifact_node_id are uncheckable.
risks: resolve_literals | medium | Uses case-insensitive fallback via lower dict; may cause false positives if two files differ only in case; settle by reviewing whether case-insensitive matching is intended.
resolve_literals | low | Sorts edges by (relation, source, target, line) but ambiguous candidates are not sorted; settle by confirming sorting consistency.

claims.text: LaTeX omits the extension on \input and \includegraphics. Trying candidates is resolution, not guessing, PROVIDED that more than one hit is reported as ambiguous rather than silently taking the first.
claims.why: The comment describes the strategy; _candidates generates suffixes, and resolve_literals reports multiple hits as ambiguous (len(uniq)>1).

claims.text: A literal that names nothing in it is COUNTED, never bound to a near-match — and one that names several is counted as ambiguous, because picking the first would be a stably reproduced fabrication.
claims.why: resolve_literals adds to unresolved when hits empty, and adds to ambiguous when len(uniq)>1; no fuzzy matching is used.

claims.text: An off-tree URL has no second node, so it is an attribute of the referring file, never an edge. Same rule as markdown.py.
claims.why: Code matches _URL and adds to rep.external instead of creating an edge.

claims.text: Deterministic; every list sorted at the end.
claims.why: All lists in rep are sorted after processing: edges by (relation, source, target, line), unresolved, ambiguous, external by (from, line, raw).
These functions are not defined in this chunk; their behavior cannot be verified.
The referenced file markdown.py is not provided.

observations.what: resolve_literals performs case-insensitive fallback via lower dict, but only on candidates not found in exact known set; this may cause unexpected matches.
The _candidates function prepends the parent directory of from_rel to raw, but only if base is not '.' or ''; this may miss cases where base is empty string.
ArtifactEdge.to_dict sorts attributes by key, but ResolveReport does not sort attributes in edges; this may cause non-deterministic dict ordering in edges.
